reason: I'm not letting an AI I've never seen talk to my customers or send sales emails in my name off the back of an ad. 'GDPR-compliant' is one line on a website; I'd need to see where my data goes and approve what it says before it goes out.
objection: If the AI support or sales manager gives a customer a wrong answer or a pushy email, it's my reputation that pays, and I can't tell where my CRM and customer data end up or who can see it.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own data where every customer-facing message needs my approval before sending, plus a signed DPA with data hosted in the EU and a reference from a similar Belgian or French business.
